findings.issue: AC1 says the allowed time, warning point and valid-from date are read 'as expires_at, warn_at, status and rule version'. Those are timer projection fields, not those values.
AC7 has two Then steps; the second should be And. 'No harness write that changes a value of section 8' clashes with runs that load values; section 8 holds rules.
TC-AD-015-06-ITG repeats 'changes a value of section 8'. Aligned with AC7 to 'a rule of section 8'.
Lines 1220 to 1300 are v3 lines. Relabelling the source as v4 without checking the range in v4 may point to the wrong lines. Reverted to v3.
